skills.name: godot4_character_body_controller
skills.skill: Implement kinematic player controllers using CharacterBody3D and CharacterBody2D with Godot 4 move_and_slide physics semantics.
procedure: Create a scene root inheriting from CharacterBody3D or CharacterBody2D with a CollisionShape child.
In _physics_process(delta), query input vectors using Input.get_vector() for normalized directional movement.
Apply project gravity using ProjectSettings.get_setting('physics/3d/default_gravity') scaled by delta when not is_on_floor().
Update velocity property directly (e.g., velocity.x, velocity.z for 3D; velocity.x, velocity.y for 2D) using lerp or move_toward for acceleration and friction.
Invoke move_and_slide() with no arguments (uses internal velocity vector in Godot 4).
Handle floor and ceiling contacts using is_on_floor() and is_on_wall() post-movement.
verification: Execute headless headless runner with `--headless --run-tests` to verify collision resolution.
Confirm velocity decays to zero when input is released without drifting.
Verify jumping is only enabled when is_on_floor() evaluates to true.
Inspect get_last_slide_collision() to confirm surface normal detection on slopes.
pitfalls: Passing velocity to move_and_slide(velocity) like in Godot 3; in Godot 4, move_and_slide takes no arguments and mutates self.velocity.
Multiplying velocity by delta before calling move_and_slide(); Godot 4 automatically handles delta time internally for slide calculations.
Relying on direct global_transform modifications instead of velocity for moving platforms or dynamic collision.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Create a CharacterBody3D script in Godot 4.7 that implements smooth WASD ground movement, jumping with gravity falloff, slope snapping, and wall slide detection without multiplying velocity by delta.

skills.name: godot4_animation_blend_tree_system
skills.skill: Build and manipulate complex node-based animation hierarchies using AnimationTree, AnimationNodeStateMachine, and AnimationMixer.
procedure: Attach an AnimationPlayer and AnimationTree to the target entity, assigning the AnimationPlayer node path to tree.anim_player.
Initialize tree.tree_root with AnimationNodeStateMachine or AnimationNodeBlendTree.
Configure state transitions via AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition with appropriate advance modes (e.g., ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO with conditions or ADVANCE_MODE_ENABLED).
Set tree.active = true after all node connections and parameters are configured.
Retrieve the playback controller using tree.get('parameters/playback') as AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback.
Drive directional blends by assigning Vector2 values to 'parameters/BlendSpace2D/blend_position' based on character velocity.
verification: Assert that tree.is_active() returns true during runtime.
Call playback.travel('TargetState') and verify current node via playback.get_current_node().
Verify crossfade blend times by asserting absence of instantaneous skeletal pops in visual test snapshots.
pitfalls: Setting tree.active = true before assigning the root AnimationNode or anim_player path, which causes silent initialization failures.
Accessing parameter paths with misspelled strings; always verify exact paths defined in the AnimationTree root graph.
Modifying bone transforms manually in _process while AnimationTree runs, causing frame conflicts unless SkeletonModifier3D is used.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Write a GDScript helper for an AnimationTree that configures an AnimationNodeStateMachine with 'Idle', 'Run', and 'Jump' states, establishes bi-directional crossfade transitions, and exposes a travel() wrapper.

skills.name: godot4_astargrid2d_tactical_navigation
skills.skill: Implement high-performance 2D grid pathfinding and dynamic obstacle updates using AStarGrid2D.
procedure: Instantiate AStarGrid2D and define the operational bounds using region (Rect2i).
Configure cell_size to match game grid tile metrics.
Set diagonal_mode (e.g., DIAGONAL_MODE_NEVER or DIAGONAL_MODE_AT_LEAST_ONE_WALKABLE) and heuristic type.
Call update() to build the internal search structure.
Synchronize obstacles by calling set_point_solid(grid_coords, true) or clear_point_solid(grid_coords).
Query paths using get_point_path(start_coords, end_coords) for world-space coordinates or get_id_path() for cell indices.
verification: Assert that paths generated around marked solid points avoid the blocked cells completely.
Verify path continuity: adjacent waypoints must never exceed cell_size * sqrt(2) distance.
Bench test path generation query duration under 100 simultaneous agent queries (<2ms on 100x100 grid).
pitfalls: Forgetting to call update() after mutating region or cell_size; queries will fail or use stale layouts.
Passing floating-point world coordinates into set_point_solid() instead of integer Vector2i grid coordinates.
Misaligning grid offsets: failing to add half cell_size offset when translating grid coordinates back to world center-points.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Implement a 2D grid navigation manager in GDScript using AStarGrid2D on a 64x64 map that supports runtime obstacle toggling, diagonal walk rules, and returns center-aligned Vector2 paths.

skills.name: godot4_compositor_effect_custom_pass
skills.skill: Implement custom viewport post-processing and compute shader render passes using Godot 4 CompositorEffect.
procedure: Create a custom resource extending CompositorEffect and set access_resolves_color and access_resolves_depth as needed.
Set effect_callback_type to the appropriate execution stage (e.g., EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_OPAQUE or EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_TRANSPARENT).
Override _render_callback(effect_callback_type, render_data) to receive Godot render pipeline contexts.
Extract RenderingDevice from RenderingServer.get_rendering_device().
Retrieve viewport color/depth buffers using render_data.get_render_scene_buffers().
Execute compute dispatch or raster blit commands through the RenderingDevice command list.
Attach the CompositorEffect resource to the Compositor resource on the active World3D or Camera3D.
verification: Confirm RenderingDevice.draw_command_begin_label() / end_label() tags match cleanly in frame capture debuggers.
Verify texture format compatibility between the scene buffer and shader pipeline inputs.
Check that rendering pipeline output contains the modified post-process result without rendering artifacts.
pitfalls: Accessing RenderSceneBuffers when using non-Vulkan rendering backends (Compatibility renderer does not support custom compute CompositorEffects).
Failing to synchronize read/write pipeline barriers on scene textures, causing flickering and GPU race conditions.
Creating RenderingDevice pipelines or allocating uniform sets per-frame inside _render_callback instead of caching them.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Construct a custom CompositorEffect resource in GDScript for Godot 4.7 that binds to the post-opaque pass, retrieves the active render scene buffers, and validates RenderingDevice availability before dispatching work.

skills.name: godot4_polyphonic_sound_system
skills.skill: Build concurrent, zero-alloc sound playback architectures using AudioStreamPolyphonic and AudioStreamPlayer.
procedure: Instantiate an AudioStreamPlayer and assign an AudioStreamPolyphonic instance to its stream property.
Set stream.polyphony to the desired concurrent voice limit (e.g., 16 or 32).
Call play() on the player node to start the polyphonic playback context.
Obtain the stream playback reference by calling player.get_stream_playback() typed as AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.
Trigger one-shot sounds by calling playback.play_stream(sample, offset, volume_db, pitch_scale).
Track returned stream IDs to allow dynamic stopping, volume fading, or pitch adjustments on active voices.
verification: Trigger 16 concurrent sounds and assert that all voices execute simultaneously without cutting off or raising node count.
Verify playback.is_stream_playing(voice_id) correctly reports true during playback and false after completion.
Monitor scene tree node count to ensure zero new nodes are spawned per sound trigger.
pitfalls: Calling get_stream_playback() before player.play(); the playback instance will be null until playback starts.
Spawning new AudioStreamPlayer nodes per sound effect, leading to memory allocations and scene tree thrashing.
Exceeding polyphony limit without voice priority management, resulting in silent dropouts of crucial audio cues.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Develop an AudioPool manager in GDScript using a single AudioStreamPlayer with AudioStreamPolyphonic that exposes play_sfx(stream: AudioStream, pitch_variance: float) and returns voice handles for dynamic control.
